# Qualitative analysis: parking permit renewal (synthetic fixture)

Two fictional residents, three sources. P1 has a follow up session.

## T1 Residents looked for proof of payment before they considered the renewal done

**Evidence.** Two of two participants looked for a receipt or bank record (RQ1).

**Quote.** “I wasn't sure the payment went through, so I checked my bank app twice.” (P1, S1 line 4). The bank app stood in for a confirmation screen.

**Quote.** “The clerk printed a receipt right away, so I knew it was done.” (P2, S3 00:02:45). The printed receipt ended the task.

## T2 Distrust of the website kept one resident at the counter

**Evidence.** One of two participants (RQ2). A weak signal.

**Quote.** “I went to the counter because I didn't trust [the city] website with my card.” (P2, S3 00:01:10).

## Recommendations

R1 rests on T1: show an immediate on-screen receipt.
